target: Add post-step output validators for steps with impact_class ∈ {structural, security_sensitive}. Routing alone cannot save the operator from model hallucination on control-plane truth maps or security risk synthesis — these step categories need a second-pass content-shape check (truth-map integrity, security-claim verification) before the artifact is treated as authoritative. Adds the validator framework + 2 initial validators (control_plane_truth_check, security_claim_verification) + integration with the contract-pipeline post-success path.
invariants: Validators run AFTER the contract pipeline succeeds, on the canonical merged artifact. A validator failure marks the artifact for soft-gate review but does not block the run unless the operator passes --strict-output-validators.
Validators are pure functions of (artifact, step_contract, step_metadata) — no side effects, no provider calls, no disk writes.
Default behavior is opt-in: validators run only when the step's impact_class is in {structural, security_sensitive}. Operators can globally enable with --validate-all-outputs.
Validator results surface in PROOF_PACK under a new `output_validator_results` section so the operator sees pass/fail per (step_id, validator_name).
Do not modify routing, cost profiles, pricing, or the contract pipeline core. Validators hook in via a new post-success callback (one-line addition to _apply_contract_pipeline).
Preserve Dopemux split authority boundaries per AGENTS.md §6.
Validators are versioned (e.g., control_plane_truth_check_v1); changing a validator's logic requires a new version + migration TP, not in-place edit.

pr.title: feat(rte): post-step output validators for structural / security_sensitive impact_class
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds the output-validator framework: pluggable validators run on canonical artifacts after contract pipeline success.
- Adds two initial validators: `control_plane_truth_check_v1` (verifies truth-map integrity — every claimed component has a code-evidence reference) and `security_claim_verification_v1` (verifies security-risk claims have severity + evidence + path/line citation).
- Wires the framework into `_apply_contract_pipeline` as a post-success callback (single-line addition).
- Validator results surface in PROOF_PACK under `output_validator_results`. Default mode is non-blocking (soft-gate); operator can `--strict-output-validators` to fail-fast on validator failure.

## Scope
Limited to new `lib/output_validators/` package, one-line addition to `run_extraction_v5._apply_contract_pipeline`, four new test files.

## Validation
Framework tests cover: validator registry; pass/fail surfacing; soft-gate vs strict mode; integration with sample artifacts. Existing promptset truth + validator repair provenance tests remain green.

## NOT_RUN
- Live LLM calls (validators don't call providers).
- Cross-packet F verification (separate F packet covers).

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- Initial validators are conservative (shape + presence checks, not semantic verification). Semantic validation would require a second LLM call which is out of scope here.
- Validator versioning is by name suffix (_v1). Future validator-v2 work needs a separate migration TP.

@codex review

steps.task: Preflight: verify TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-E8-YAML-V3-001 is merged (impact_class field is needed). Worktree clean.

Design the validator base interface in `lib/output_validators/base.py`. ABC with `name: str`, `version: int`, `applies_to_impact_classes: set[str]`, `validate(artifact, step_contract, step_metadata) -> ValidatorResult` where ValidatorResult is a dataclass with status (pass/fail/skip), reason, finding_details.
validation: Sample concrete subclass passes type checks.

steps.task: Implement the registry in `lib/output_validators/registry.py`. `register(validator)` decorator; `validators_for_impact_class(impact_class)` returns the relevant validators in deterministic order; `run_validators_for_step(step_id, step_contract, step_metadata, artifact)` returns a list of ValidatorResult.
validation: Registry is module-level, idempotent (re-registering same name+version raises).

steps.task: Implement `control_plane_truth_check_v1`. Validates: every claimed component (service / module / class) in the truth-map artifact has an associated code-evidence reference (path + line_range OR file SHA). Conservative — only flags missing references, not semantic mismatch. Applies to: impact_class=structural.
validation: On a sample R0 control-plane artifact with one missing evidence ref: validator returns fail with finding_details naming the affected component.
On a complete artifact: returns pass.

steps.task: Implement `security_claim_verification_v1`. Validates: every security-risk claim has (severity ∈ {low,medium,high,critical}); (evidence list non-empty); (path + line citation present). Conservative — does not verify the claim's truthfulness, only its shape. Applies to: impact_class=security_sensitive.
validation: On a sample R11 security artifact with one finding missing severity: validator returns fail.
On a complete artifact: returns pass.

steps.task: Wire the framework into `_apply_contract_pipeline` in run_extraction_v5.py. After successful merge (existing code path), if the step's impact_class triggers validators, call `run_validators_for_step` and attach results to `request_meta['output_validator_results']`. If `cfg.strict_output_validators` AND any result is fail, raise OutputValidatorFailure (handled by the existing error path).
validation: Hook is a single-call addition (≤5 lines).
Existing contract pipeline tests remain green.
Validator results surface in spend ledger / PROOF_PACK pipeline as designed.

steps.task: Add `--strict-output-validators` CLI flag (default False = soft-gate). Update RunnerConfig accordingly.
Write test_output_validator_registry.py (6+ tests): register / lookup / duplicate-version raise / ordering deterministic / lookup by impact_class / unknown impact_class returns empty.

Write test_control_plane_truth_check.py (5+ tests): pass on complete artifact; fail on missing path; fail on missing line_range; pass on file SHA reference (alt evidence form); applies-to filter works (skipped for impact_class=routine).
Write test_security_claim_verification.py (5+ tests): pass on complete claim; fail on missing severity; fail on invalid severity; fail on empty evidence; fail on missing path/line citation.

Write test_output_validators_integration.py (5+ tests): _apply_contract_pipeline hooks invoke validators; results surface in request_meta; --strict mode raises on validator fail; soft-gate mode does not raise; PROOF_PACK output_validator_results section is populated.
Run pal/codereview + pal/precommit. Commit allowlisted files; push; open PR.
